Title: Senior Backend Developer
Company: Nexus Cloud Technologies
Location: Remote / San Francisco, CA

Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Backend Engineer to lead the architecture and scaling of our distributed services. You will design resilient APIs and manage large relational and caching databases.

Responsibilities:
• Architect, build, and maintain mission-critical backend services and APIs using Node.js or Python.
• Lead database schema optimization and indexing across PostgreSQL and Redis clusters.
• Drive microservices modularization and containerized deployments using Docker and Kubernetes.
• Collaborate with frontend and mobile teams to define GraphQL and REST contracts.
• Mentor junior engineers and champion test-driven development and CI/CD automation.

Required Qualifications:
• 3+ years of professional backend engineering experience.
• Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript (Node.js/Express) or Python.
• Extensive experience with SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL or MySQL).
• Deep understanding of RESTful API design, data structures, and microservices.
• Practical familiarity with Git, Docker, and cloud deployments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Familiarity with Redis, Kafka, or RabbitMQ message queues.
• Experience with GraphQL and Kubernetes orchestrations.
• Contributions to open-source software libraries.
